description: This file defines a static class 'ConsistentRingInstruments' that manages metrics instruments related to a consistent ring, including ring size and percentage metrics, using the System.Diagnostics.Metrics API.

classes.name: ConsistentRingInstruments
classes.description: A static class providing registration methods for metrics instruments related to consistent ring metrics.

methods.name: RegisterRingSizeObserve
methods.description: Registers an observable gauge for ring size, accepting a function to observe the current ring size.

methods.name: RegisterMyRangeRingPercentageObserve
methods.description: Registers an observable gauge for the local size percentage of the ring, accepting a function to observe this value.

methods.name: RegisterAverageRingPercentageObserve
methods.description: Registers an observable gauge for the average size percentage of the ring, accepting a function to observe this value.
